newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-IVANOV TO JOIN AUSTRIA VIENNA FROM RAPID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IVANOV TO JOIN AUSTRIA VIENNA FROM RAPID.

text.p: Bulgarian defender Trifon Ivanov is to join first division club Austria Vienna from Rapid Vienna, club officials said on Wednesday.
Ivanov, 32, who played in the 1994 World Cup, is to sign a two-year contract for an undisclosed sum on Friday.
"We have been negotiating with Rapid about Ivanov for some time now. We are happy to have him on board," said Austria Vienna president Rudolf Streicher.
Ivanov played for Rapid for two years, helping them reach the European Cup Winners' Cup final and also lift the Austrian league title in the 1995-96 season.
However, a series of suspensions led Rapid coach Ernst Dokupil to exclude the temperamental Ivanov from the team in the final stages of last season.
